## What I Work On {#research}

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-4}
### 📋 CMS Claims Data
Large-scale Medicare & Medicaid data — harmonization, linkage, and analytics across millions of beneficiaries.
:::

::: {.g-col-4}
### 🔗 Causal Inference
Propensity scoring, instrumental variables, and difference-in-differences to answer real-world treatment questions.
:::

::: {.g-col-4}
### 📈 Survival & Longitudinal Analysis
Time-to-event modeling, competing risks, and repeated measures in aging populations.
:::

::: {.g-col-4}
### 🤖 Machine Learning
Gradient boosting, survival ML, and NLP for clinical text — actively building applied skills for EHR and claims data.
:::

::: {.g-col-4}
### 🛠️ Tools
Stata · R · Python · SQL

::: {.g-col-4}
### 🏥 Domain
Geriatrics · ADRD · Emergency & Hospital Visit Outcomes · Palliative Medicine & Health Services Research · Social Gerontology
:::

:::

---

## Featured Projects

**[Japan Loneliness Study](https://github.com/honoluluhan717/Japan-loneliness-study)** — Stata code and analysis pipeline for a published mediation analysis examining mobile phone use and loneliness among older Japanese adults. *Innovation in Aging, 2020.*

**[WTC First Responders Frailty Study](wtc-frailty.qmd)** *(Ongoing)* — Lead biostatistician on a clinical study examining frailty trajectories in World Trade Center first responders. Responsible for statistical analysis plan, modeling, and results interpretation.

**[ADRD Drug Repurposing Study](adrd-repurposing.qmd)** *(In Progress)* — Lead analyst using large-scale CMS claims data to identify candidate drugs for Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias (ADRD) repurposing. Applying causal inference methods to observational claims data.

**[Palliative Care at Home RCT](palliative-care-rct.qmd)** *(Recruitment Ongoing)* — Biostatistician on a randomized controlled trial evaluating a home-based palliative care intervention. Responsible for research database management, CONSORT diagram design, and statistical analysis planning.

---

## Currently Learning

I'm actively building toward health data science and applied ML roles — redoing past analyses in Python, working through survival ML methods, and developing explainability skills (SHAP) for clinical model deployment.

---

*Open to roles in health data science, real-world evidence (RWE), and applied ML in clinical settings.*
